subject: general
question: Which additional duty was added in 2002 by the 86th Amendment of the Constitution, under clause K of the fundamental duties of India?

options.text: To safeguard public property and to abjure violence
To value and preserve the rich heritage of our composite culture
Who is a parent or guardian, to provide opportunities for education to his child or, as the case may be, ward, between the age of six and fourteen years.
To defend the country and render national service when called upon to do so

solution:
The correct answer is __**Who is a p**____**arent or guardian, to provide op22portunities for education to his child or, as the case may be, ward, between the age of six and fourteen years.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• **Ten Fundamental Duties** were introduced to the Indian Constitution by the **42nd Amendment Act **of 1976.
 
• Later, the **11th Fundamental Duty** was added to the list by the **86th Amendment Act **of **2002**.
 
• Fundamental Duties, which were felt to be necessary during the internal crises of **1975–1977, **were recommended by the** Swaran Singh Committee** in 1976.
 
• Under **Part-IV A **of the **Indian Constitution,** **Article 51A **addresses the** Fundamental Duties.**
 
• In addition to fostering and producing culture, basic obligations imposed by the 42nd Amendment Act of the Constitution in 1976 also give the **legislature more power** to uphold these **obligations **in relation to basic rights.
 
• To his **ward **or **child **between the ages of **six **and fourteen, provide **educational possibilities**.
 
• This **86th Constitutional Amendment** Act of **2002 added this duty**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• **Importance** of Fundamental Duties:

 
 
• They **serve **as a **reminder **to **Indian citizens** of their **obligations **to society, their fellow citizens, and the country.
 
• They **caution **people to **avoid **engaging in **anti-social **and **anti-national behavior.**
 
• They **motivate **others and instill a **sense **of **devotion **and **discipline **in them.
 
• They assist the courts in **reviewing **and **determining **whether a **statute **is **constitutional**.
